description:
SUMMARY
Luxury Two-Bedroom Penthouse – Centenary Plaza, Holliday Street with allocated parking

DESCRIPTION
Situated within the highly sought-after Centenary Plaza development on Holliday Street, this impressive two-bedroom penthouse offers elevated city living in the heart of Birmingham.
Finished to a high standard throughout, the property boasts two generous double bedrooms, both benefiting from stylish en-suite bathrooms, providing the perfect blend of comfort and privacy. A separate contemporary family bathroom further enhances the practicality of the layout, ideal for guests.
The standout feature of this penthouse is the spacious open-plan living and dining area, flooded with natural light and designed for modern lifestyles. From here, you have access to two private balconies, offering exceptional outdoor space and far-reaching views across Birmingham’s skyline—perfect for relaxing or entertaining.
Residents of Centenary Plaza enjoy a prime city centre location just moments from Brindleyplace, The Mailbox, and Birmingham New Street Station, along with access to on-site amenities including concierge and gym facilities.
The property also benefits from secure allocated parking, adding further convenience in this central location.
Key Features:

Prestigious Centenary Plaza development
Two double bedrooms, both with en-suites
Additional modern family bathroom
Spacious open-plan living area
Two private balconies with city views
Allocated parking space
Concierge and residents’ amenities
Prime city centre location

.

Entrance  
Grand entrance with fitted panelling, storage and doors off to:

Open plan living  29' 7" x 21' 4" ( 9.02m x 6.50m )
The apartment features a sleek, modern kitchen designed to maximise both style and functionality. Its open-plan layout allows it to flow seamlessly into the living space, creating an inviting area perfect for cooking, dining, and entertaining. Clean lines, contemporary finishes, and thoughtful design touches make this kitchen a standout feature of the home.
Fully equipped with integrated appliances, including an oven, hob, extractor fan, and fridge-freezer, dishwasher the kitchen offers all the essentials for everyday living. Ample cabinet space and smart storage solutions keep the area clutter-free, while the spacious worktops provide plenty of room for meal preparation.

Bedroom One 17' 9" x 21' 4" ( 5.41m x 6.50m )
Having carpet flooring, fitted wardrobes and access to balcony.

Ensuite  
A well-appointed ensuite bathroom featuring a walk-in shower, wash basin, and WC, offering convenience and privacy.

Bedroom Two  12' 6" x 12' 3" ( 3.81m x 3.73m )
Having carpet flooring, fitted wardrobes and access to balcony.

Ensuite  
A well-appointed ensuite bathroom featuring a walk-in shower, wash basin, and WC, offering convenience and privacy.

Family Bathroom  
The bathroom is well presented and fitted with a modern suite comprising a panelling bath with shower over, low-level WC, wash-hand basin, fully tiled, spotlights, vanity mirror, tiled flooring, wall mounted heater.

Penthouse Balcony  
Private penthouse balcony with far-reaching city views.

Agents Note  
The property benefits from quadruple glazing in the bedrooms and secondary glazing in the living area which is noise resistant as well as keeping the place warm.
